transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Well, hello, Doctor. I guess what made me come in today is that my eating has gotten all turned around lately. Some days I just... I forget to eat lunch completely. And then other days, I'll find myself just standing at the kitchen counter, eating crackers and sweets, even though nothing really tastes right to me anymore. It's just very strange for me.
Have you been making yourself sick, using laxatives, or doing anything else to try to compensate for eating when you feel like you've eaten too much?
No, no, I haven't done anything like that. I don't make myself throw up or take anything to get rid of it. I just... I eat it and then I feel bad about it, but I don't do anything to try and undo it.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy doing, or do you not get pleasure from them anymore?

Yes, I suppose I have. I used to really look forward to my watercolor class, and the quilting circle... even my book club. But lately, I just pack my bag, leave it by the door, and then I just... I can't make myself care enough to actually go. I just stay home instead.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?

Yes, I have. Most mornings I wake up with this... this heavy, low feeling. It's like the color has gone out of the day before I even get dressed. It's just been there, almost every day, for a while now.
Have you been feeling tired or lacking energy most of the time, even when you haven't done much physically?

No, not really. I mean, I'm not doing much these days since I just stay home, but my body doesn't feel overly tired. I have the energy if I needed it, I just... I just don't really want to use it. But no, I haven't been feeling physically exhausted or anything like that.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yes, I have. Actually, that's really what made me come in. My eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I completely forget to eat lunch. And then other days... well, I'll just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets, even though nothing really tastes right to me anymore.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much or that you're letting people down, even when there's no real reason for it?

No, not really. I mean... I know I've been feeling low, but I don't feel worthless. And I don't think I'm letting anyone down. It's just me at home mostly these days, so... no, I haven't really had those kinds of thoughts about myself.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, have you been more restless or fidgety lately?

Yes, I suppose I have noticed a bit of both, actually. My body just feels slowed down lately. It's like... it takes me twice as long just to cross the living room, or even to button my sweater in the morning. But then, on the other hand, sometimes I do get a bit restless. I'll find myself just pacing around the house, carrying the same stack of papers in my hand for no real reason. So, yes, my movements have definitely been a bit different.
Have you found it harder to focus on things, like reading or following a TV show, or do you feel like your thoughts are foggy lately?

Yes, actually, I have. It's... well, it's just been really hard to think straight. I'll sit there staring at simple things, like trying to decide whether to call the pharmacy or open the mail first. And my mind just gets so foggy trying to figure it out that I end up doing neither. It's like I just can't focus enough to make a simple choice.
Have you had thoughts about death or dying, or have you thought about hurting yourself in any way?

Well, no, I wouldn't say I have any actual plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do have these thoughts sometimes. Just thinking that, well, if I went to sleep and just didn't wake up the next morning... it might just be a relief. For everyone, really. It just crosses my mind now and then.
Have you found it harder to think clearly or make decisions lately, even about simple things?

Well, I think... like I was just saying a moment ago, yes. It's exactly like that example I just gave you, about struggling to decide between opening the mail and calling the pharmacy. It's just very hard to make up my mind about simple things right now. But other than what I already mentioned, I don't really have anything else to add about it.
Beyond the activities you’ve already mentioned, have you lost interest in most things that you used to enjoy, even things that used to make you happy?

Yes, I have. I used to really enjoy my activities... I had a watercolor class, my quilting circle, and a book club. But lately, I'll pack my bag and just leave it sitting by the door. I just can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go anymore. It's just not the same.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost pleasure in most or all of the things you used to enjoy, like even the smallest parts of your daily routine or hobbies?

Well, I think I just answered that, really. Like I said, I've stopped going to my watercolor class, the quilting circle, and the book club. I just don't have the interest or find any joy in them right now. I don't really have anything else to add beyond what I just told you.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost pleasure in most or all of the things you used to enjoy, like even the smallest parts of your daily routine or hobbies?

I know I just mentioned this, but yes, it's pretty much everything. Like I said about my watercolor class, the quilting circle, and my book club... I used to really look forward to them. They were the best parts of my week. Now, I just pack my bag, leave it by the door, and I just can't make myself care enough to actually go. There's just no joy in it anymore, or in much of anything else, really.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping too much?
No, I haven't really had any trouble with that. I sleep... pretty much normally, I think. I usually just go to bed and sleep right through the night, so I haven't noticed any changes there.
Have you lost interest in pretty much all activities, even ones that don’t require much effort, like watching TV, reading, or just getting dressed for the day?

I feel like we just went over this, doctor. But yes, it's really everything. Like I was saying about my watercolor class and the quilting circle and my book club. I used to really enjoy them, but lately... well, I pack my bag and leave it by the door, and then I just can't bring myself to care enough to actually go out and do it. It's just like that with everything right now.

inference_history.note: Initial presentation includes irregular eating patterns and anhedonia ("nothing really tastes right"). Candidates include Eating Disorder NOS (F50.80), Major Depressive Disorder (F32.0), Adjustment Disorder (F43.20), and unspecified feeding or eating disorder (F50.00). No differential ruled out yet.

Ruled out F50.80 (other specified eating disorder) due to the patient not engaging in compensatory behaviors and the emphasis on mood symptoms, which makes a depressive disorder more likely. The eating symptoms may be related to depression.

The patient denied feeling tired or lacking energy, which reduces the likelihood of F43.20 (Adjustment Disorder with Depressed Mood) as a primary diagnosis, since low energy is a core symptom. The presentation is more consistent with a Major Depressive Disorder (F32.0) or Binge Eating Disorder (F50.00), though the lack of compensatory behaviors makes F50.00 less likely.

The patient continues to endorse symptoms of depression, including loss of interest in previously enjoyed activities, persistent low mood, and disturbances in eating patterns. However, there is no evidence of compensatory behaviors (e.g., purging, laxative use) or feelings of worthlessness, which may have pointed more strongly toward an eating disorder or more severe depressive features. No new disorder is added or ruled out at this turn.
